blind.description: A low stylized wooden barrier or fence segment consisting of three vertical posts capped with low pyramidal tops, a continuous horizontal top rail running through the posts, and lower inset horizontal beams painted with a decorative red and cream/light wood band pattern. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with hand-painted stylized wood grain textures. The posts sit directly on the ground plane without any separate base plinth.
blind.from_above: A straight narrow horizontal strip showing the three square pyramidal post tops linked by a central horizontal rail, with ends slightly projecting past the outer posts.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the figure (around 2.5 to 3 feet tall) and roughly 1.3 to 1.5 times as wide as the figure is tall (around 7 to 8 feet wide).
